page.content:
Illinois town where Michael returns every Halloween myth.

How Haddonfield connects

  • Event: The Night He Came Home — The Night He Came Home happens in Haddonfield.
  • Work: Halloween (1978) — The 1978 film is set on Halloween night in Haddonfield.
  • Character: Michael Myers — Michael returns to walk Haddonfield.
  • Location: Myers house — The Myers house stands in Haddonfield.
  • Faction: Strode family — The Strodes are a Haddonfield family.
  • Character: Annie Brackett — Annie babysits in Haddonfield on Halloween night.

What is Haddonfield?

Haddonfield is the Midwestern town of tree-lined streets, the Myers house, and the night Laurie babysits while the Shape walks.

Key threads lead to The Night He Came Home, Halloween (1978), Michael Myers, Myers house, Strode family and Annie Brackett.
